findings.title: Section heading "Layanan Kami" is view-authored, not config-sourced
findings.detail: The Hard rule bars hard-coding organisation/tagline/service content; "Layanan Kami" is a section label (chrome), not organisation data, and matches the sibling AboutView pattern — noted for visibility, not a Hard-rule violation.

findings.title: Page metadata (title Beranda) is not tested
findings.detail: Nothing imports beranda/page, so its metadata is never checked; add expect(metadata.title).toBe('Beranda').

findings.title: Layout test depends on MUI internal class names
findings.detail: Lines 51-59 check MuiGrid-grid-xs-12 / MuiGrid-grid-md-4; ties the suite to MUI class naming and still cannot prove the 375px layout in jsdom.

findings.title: card transition classes overlap and contradict each other
findings.detail: transition-shadow is always on and overridden by motion-safe:transition-all, so reduced-motion users still get an animation; a hover lift makes non-clickable cards look clickable.

findings.title: numbered CustomAvatar badge the unit didn't ask for
findings.detail: Decoration outside the spec (title + paragraph per service), adds an @core import.

findings.title: Test imports view via alias instead of the established self-import convention
findings.detail: Every existing folder-colocated test (src/configs/companyProfile/index.test.ts:10, src/libs/api/query-params/index.test.ts:3, src/libs/jwt-permission/index.test.ts:3, src/libs/query-keys/index.test.ts:3, ContactForm/index.test.tsx:18, AboutView/index.test.tsx:16) imports the module under test with `import X from '.'`; this test uses `@views/company-profile/HomeView`. Change to `import HomeView from '.'`.

findings.title: companyProfile import uses `@configs/*` instead of the feature's established `@/configs/*` alias
findings.detail: Sibling files (AboutView/index.tsx:23, AboutView/index.test.tsx:12, kontak/page.tsx:21) use `@/configs/companyProfile`; this bolt's page.tsx:18 and HomeView/index.tsx:29 use `@configs/companyProfile` (resolves identically, naming split within the feature).
